cases.description: Upsert VantagePipeline with on_stage1_detection, detection_crop, camera_vlm, signal_schema, and managed provenance

Persist recorded_block VantageObservation with <= 32 KiB Baseline JFIF crop_jpeg, Ash bbox map, and GIN search_tsv match
Persist live_keyframe_tap VantageObservation with catalog_entry_id null linked to camera_source_id
Upsert VantageWorkerRegistration active_for_capability plus DashboardPackage/Instance provenance and dashboards.packages.manage RBAC
Enforce exact 32768-byte crop_jpeg acceptance and 32769-byte rejection at both Ash validation and PostgreSQL CHECK constraint
Reject Progressive SOF2 (0xC2) and non-JFIF bytes in crop_jpeg
Reject out-of-bounds or inverted bbox coordinates and out-of-range confidence (< 0.0 or > 1.0)
Enforce Ash RBAC fail-closed: deny non-system writes to VantageObservation/VantageJob and reject bare devices.view without devices.cameras.recordings.view
Reject invalid time_basis, invalid source_mode, recorded_block missing catalog_entry_id, and invalid VantagePipeline pipeline_id or empty version

Terminal reclaim (local_state=reclaimed with archive_state=deleted or not_required) purges observations and cancels active jobs

Live-tap observations (catalog_entry_id null) survive sibling recorded block reclaim on the same camera
Updating unrelated catalog fields (e.g., archive_state pending -> verified while local_state=present) does not fire observation purge
Ingest valid recorded_block vantage.result.v1 over JetStream media.results.vantage.v1, complete job, and emit OCSF class 1008 with signal_schema metadata

Ingest valid live_keyframe_tap result envelope (job_id null, catalog_entry_id null, external_python) and broadcast VantagePubSub

Reject alpr_plate_read signal_schema violations (regex mismatch, missing required field, wrong type) with TerminalMessageError and failed_terminal job
Reject 32769-byte crop_jpeg_b64 and non-JPEG crop payloads cleanly as terminal drop without persisting unvalidated rows
Reject inverted/out-of-range bbox and out-of-range confidence (1.05 / -0.1) as terminal drop
Reject quarantined catalog_entry_id, descriptor_sha256 mismatch, or unknown job_id with zero observation writes
Reject > 960 KiB payload (983041 B), invalid schema_version (vantage.result.v99), and missing recorded_block IDs without crashing EventWriter pipeline

Skip distant 76.8px detection (1920x1080 [0.40, 0.40, 0.44, 0.50]) with explicit crop_below_min_dimension reason

Reject zero-area, inverted, negative, out-of-unit, and NaN bounding boxes cleanly without panic
Reject empty 0x0 frame, max_dimension=0, and max_bytes < 512 with typed configuration/frame errors

Execute single-frame Ramp 1 VLM job sending enable_thinking=false, response_format, SHA-256 verify, and publish-before-ACK to media.results.vantage.v1

Decode and SHA-256 verify identical synthetic CMAF blocks across both local NVR byte-range and archive presigned range read grants
Strip closed <think> blocks cleanly while rejecting unclosed <think> as truncated_thinking with zero fabricated observations
Reject non-JSON prose and plate_text regex violations from VLM without fabricating observations
